description: Na₁₀(UO₂)₈(W₅O₂₀)O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two WO₆ octahedra, corners with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-69°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three WO₆ octahedra, corners with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 59-66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.60 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and edges with five NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.70 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.79 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.97 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one WO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 63°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.70 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.71 Å. There are four inequivalent U sites. In the first U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two WO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-60°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.56 Å. In the second U site, U is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.63 Å. In the third U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two WO₆ octahedra, corners with three NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-62°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.55 Å. In the fourth U site, U is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.62 Å. There are three inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one WO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one WO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-69°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.26 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one WO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one WO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 58°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.26 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are two shorter (1.81 Å) and two longer (1.82 Å) W-O bond lengths. There are twenty-two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one U atom to form distorted ONa₃U tetrahedra that share corners with four ONa₃U tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₃U tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONaU₃ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form ONa₃W tetrahedra that share corners with two ONa₃U tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃W tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two U and one W atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one U and one W atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one U and two W atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one U and two W atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to one Na and three U atoms to form distorted ONaU₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃U tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaU₃ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃U tetrahedra. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three U atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three U atoms. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one U and one W atom. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the nineteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two U, and one W atom. In the twentieth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the twenty-first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to three U atoms. In the twenty-second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one U atom to form distorted ONa₃U tetrahedra that share corners with four ONa₃U tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaU₃ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃U tetrahedra.
